purpose: Decorative blue ink backgrounds behind Timeline, Visit Details, outing details, Saved Locations, Country Days, Export, and Settings. These illustrations do not represent a user's recorded geography or a photographed visit. The main Map screen remains full-screen without a decorative header or top banner.

assets.prompt: Create a production UI illustration asset for Whereday iPhone app, transparent background PNG. A wide horizontal canopy of exuberant fluffy CUMULUS CLOUDS drawn entirely in cobalt blue ballpoint pen, loose overlapping irregular pen lines, scribbled crosshatching shading along bottoms, varied big and small cloud lobes, a few tiny hand-drawn blue flying birds. Handmade observational travel sketchbook, literary and charming, slightly imperfect. Composition landscape 3:2, clouds cluster thickly along the TOP and RIGHT edges and a smaller cluster on LEFT edge, with generous TRANSPARENT negative space in lower center for UI headings below. All art contained within image without abruptly clipped pen strokes, edges dissolve into sparse hatching. ONLY deep cobalt/indigo ink lines (#354f86) and a very small amount pale blue watercolor wash within cloud shading, NO white fills: clouds themselves largely transparent so paper shows through. No paper texture, no cream background, NO TEXT, no labels, no UI, no border, no drop shadow, no devices, no logos. This will frame live native iPhone screens, not a full mockup. Return a genuinely transparent background.

Production iPhone app decorative illustration. A wide low vignette of a charming neighborhood cafe with striped awning, empty sidewalk chairs, potted plants, leafy tree, a small streetlamp and a few cumulus clouds and birds overhead. Hand drawn entirely in cobalt blue ballpoint pen with fine irregular outlines, energetic SCRIBBLED crosshatching, dense blue ink shade and generous unpainted transparent space. Travel sketchbook, handmade and very textured, delicate and literary. Transparent background PNG. Use ONLY blue pen lines, no solid colored backdrop, no blue glow or haze, no gradient, no white or cream paper, no painted white cloud fill. Blue line art on actual transparency with fully transparent sky and gaps between pen marks. Landscape composition 3:2 with cafe in lower right, airy clouds upper right and lots of empty space upper left. No words, lettering, logos, UI or watermarks. Artwork is generic decorative street scenery, not a photograph of a named place. All objects contained within frame; ends taper into sparse sketch marks.

rendering: Fixed, noninteractive SwiftUI backgrounds tinted with the adaptive blue ink accent, with foreground paper surfaces for legibility. Export, Settings, and editors use a fainter wash. Decorations are hidden from accessibility and do not reserve foreground content space. MapKit maps remain interactive. Onboarding and PaywallView are outside this implementation.
